paper_title: Solar neutrino limit on axions and keV-mass bosons
notes: Headline limit g_agamma < 7e-10 GeV^-1 from Eq. (4), derived from the SNO all-flavor 8B solar neutrino flux constraint L_a < 0.1 L_sun (Eq. 3) using the Schlattl et al. solar-model scaling (Eq. 1). This is a mass-independent (flat) bound; the paper states the solar interior temperature ~1 keV means the limit applies to sub-keV mass particles, so the flat line is reported from very low mass up to 1 keV (1e3 eV). No local dark-matter density assumed (solar energy-loss argument), so no rho_DM rescaling. The paper does not quote a formal confidence level for Eq. (4) (it follows from a 'reasonably conservative' 50% allowance on the neutrino flux); 0.95 is recorded as nominal. The paper's secondary result, keV-mass boson-electron couplings g_chi-ee (Fig. 1, PS/S/V), is not the main result and is not reported here.
